findings.reason: Verified: `.small-action` is now a flex container. `.small-action-desc` has no flex-grow, so on short actions it shrinks to its text, and the float:right edit/delete buttons inside it (small-action.hbs) end up next to the text instead of at the row's right edge; this is a real layout regression the PR introduces.

Verified: mobile/topic-post.scss gives `.custom-message` `margin-left: -40px`, which was sized for the old 4em left padding; with padding now `0 1.5%` and the icon as a separate flex item beside it, the message gets pulled over the icon column, a plausible visual overlap on mobile.
Correct: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property, and the legacy box-syntax fallbacks are incomplete, but this is prefix cleanup with no failing modern browser.
Float on a flex item is indeed ignored, but `clear: both` on the container still controls how it sits next to preceding sibling floats, so that part of the claim is wrong, and this is cleanup anyway.
